# Hashtag Web3 — Developer Portal, Public API & Agent Context

> Scoped documentation index for developers, LLMs, and autonomous agents integrating with Hashtag Web3 APIs, OpenAPI specifications, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and CLI tools.

## When to use this

Use Hashtag Web3 developer endpoints and tools for:
- **Web3 Job Search**: Query live blockchain, Solidity, Rust, and crypto jobs via `GET /api/v1/jobs` (or `/api/jobs`).
- **Crypto & Web3 News**: Real-time aggregated industry headlines via `GET /api/v1/news`.
- **Global Web3 Events**: Upcoming conferences, hackathons, and builder summits via `GET /api/v1/events`.
- **Blockchain Technical Glossary**: 200+ definitions covering DeFi, consensus, and cryptography via `GET /api/v1/glossary`.
- **MCP Tool Calling**: Model Context Protocol streamable-http integration via `POST /.well-known/mcp`.

## When NOT to Use

Do NOT use Hashtag Web3 for:
- General non-blockchain jobs
- Live token price tickers or financial execution
- Wallet transactions, token swaps, or on-chain signing

## REST API Endpoints (v1 & Public)

- `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/v1/jobs`: Search and paginate live Web3 jobs (`search`, `tag`, `company`, `limit`, `offset`, `cursor`).
- `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/v1/news`: Real-time aggregated crypto headlines (`search`, `limit`).
- `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/v1/events`: Global Web3 conferences and hackathons (`search`, `type`, `country`, `limit`, `offset`).
- `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/v1/glossary`: 200+ blockchain glossary definitions (`search`, `category`, `limit`).
- `POST https://hashtagweb3.com/api/mcp`: Model Context Protocol Streamable HTTP endpoint for AI tool calling.

## Sandbox & Test Environment (Zero-Auth & Mock Payloads)

- **Sandbox Root**: `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/sandbox`
- **Instant Sandbox Key Registration**: `POST https://hashtagweb3.com/api/sandbox/auth/register` (body: `{"agent_id": "your-agent"}`)
- **Sandbox Jobs**: `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/sandbox/jobs`
- **Sandbox Glossary**: `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/sandbox/glossary`
- **Sandbox News**: `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/sandbox/news`
- **Sandbox Events**: `GET https://hashtagweb3.com/api/sandbox/events`
- **Echo Header/Payload Test**: `POST https://hashtagweb3.com/api/sandbox/echo`

## Official CLI Tool

```bash
# Run directly via npx
npx hashtagweb3 jobs --search "Solidity" --limit 5
npx hashtagweb3 news --limit 5
npx hashtagweb3 events --type conference
npx hashtagweb3 glossary --search "Zero Knowledge"

# Install globally
npm install -g hashtagweb3
```

## Rate Limits & Response Headers
- Default public rate limit: 120 requests/minute per IP.
- Standard RFC rate limit response headers on all API endpoints:
  - `RateLimit-Limit: 120`
  - `RateLimit-Remaining: 119`
  - `RateLimit-Reset: 60`
  - `RateLimit-Policy: 120;w=60`
  - `Retry-After: 60` (on 429 status code)
  - `API-Version: 1.0.0`
  - `Deprecation: @1767225600`
  - `Sunset: Wed, 31 Dec 2026 23:59:59 GMT`

## Machine-Readable Specifications

- [OpenAPI 3.1 JSON](https://hashtagweb3.com/openapi.json): Complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 specification.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 YAML](https://hashtagweb3.com/api/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 YAML schema.
- [MCP Server Manifest](https://hashtagweb3.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol server definition.
- [Agent Manifest](https://hashtagweb3.com/.well-known/agents.json): Standardized agent capabilities and tool definitions.
- [Agent Auth Guide](https://hashtagweb3.com/auth.md): WorkOS auth.md compliant authentication guide for AI agents.
- [RFC 9727 API Catalog](https://hashtagweb3.com/.well-known/api-catalog): Standardized linkset API catalog.
- [RFC 9728 OAuth Protected Resource](https://hashtagweb3.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource)
- [RFC 8414 OAuth Authorization Server](https://hashtagweb3.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server)
- [Developer Portal UI](https://hashtagweb3.com/developers): Interactive web documentation, quickstart guides, and code samples.

## GitHub Codebase & Agent Configuration
- [Public GitHub Repository](https://github.com/vedangvatsa/Web3-Jobs): Authoritative open-source repository containing the Hashtag Web3 site and integration code.
- [Agent Plugin Manifest (plugin.json)](https://hashtagweb3.com/plugin.json): Agent-plugins.org compliant plugin configuration manifest.
- [Agent Skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/vedangvatsa/Web3-Jobs/blob/main/SKILL.md): Self-publishing skills.sh capabilities mapping document.
- [Agent Coding Rules (AGENTS.md)](https://github.com/vedangvatsa/Web3-Jobs/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Coding rules and system prompt directives for autonomous coding agents.
- [Cursor Rules (.cursorrules)](https://github.com/vedangvatsa/Web3-Jobs/blob/main/.cursorrules): Development instruction rules for Cursor/AI IDE workflows.
